experiment: QNN Owen values with E/M/X coalition structure

partition_semantics.M: local non-Clifford feature/readout rotations with primarily single-qubit processing role
partition_semantics.X: local non-Clifford rotations embedded in entangling motifs: cross-feature CX-P-CX phases and classifier-preparing RY gates
partition_semantics.passive: all Hadamard gates are locked/passive background gates

value_function: one-shot test accuracy; first-qubit readout; no retraining
estimator_note: For each sampled Owen visit (R,T), v(Q_R union T) and v(Q_R union T union {i}) are each evaluated K fresh times; the two K-means are differenced and then averaged over sampled visits.
